evidence: Literal source-derived expectations checked by an independent Python evaluator. No production output, desktop execution or native capture oracle; no live state/save/UI/protocol changes.

attachments.derivation: Reuse the independently pinned P0 normalAttachments matrix verbatim. Junction/slope/special attachment only admits an existing edge; 60 patterns x 8 headings, with both connectivity states for normal rails. Direction scan retains lowest-index qualifying edge on open rails.

detachments.derivation: Every serialized pattern against each of the 12 legal normal route edge pairs. Single clears on either hit; junction clears on two, converts on one, remains on zero; slopes do nothing. A one-hit junction can leave an acute pair: RailPattern.get asserts and returns null. Keep that source hazard distinct from P4 checked invalid-pattern rejection/rollback.

connectivity.derivation: isWellConnected counts two same-Z reciprocal neighbors; missing, wrong-facing and different-Z neighbors do not qualify. These concrete contexts feed the attachment matrix, independently of its boolean input.

routes.derivation: Literal ordered route coordinates and patterns use inclusive sign-vector walking, not pathfinding. Cost is calculated independently in raw source units; quoted reclaimed entity values are per cell even for a shared entity. Preview deltas are zero and commit spend is the quote. Rejected and coincident work spend zero. Concrete runtime side effects are later gates.

slopes.derivation: Hand-derived four cardinal footprints, rail levels 0..3 and their complementary eight-cell ownership. Base Z (not rail Z) selects per-position art. NE/SE/SW/NW paired flags are stored once; filler above/support below are separate. All eight occupancy positions, ceiling and diagonal rejection are explicit.

supports.derivation: Election scans Z0 through railZ-1 before allocating from ground. Any occupant, including buried/transparent, suppresses supports but not rail legality. Teardown is owner agnostic and type filtered; retain non-piers and piers at/above the selected rail.

normalRemoval.derivation: Source count includes all non-car rail types even when detach does nothing. Every visited column tears down piers independently of rail subtype/edges/occupancy/owner. Invalid junction patterns reject the planned transaction, including booking/support changes.

specialRails.derivation: Different endpoints; cardinal bridge/tunnel/garage and eight-way girder. Inclusive bridge/girder costs include wrong subtype and train skips. Tunnel bills new cells and restores only matching [from,to) cells. Garage replaces inclusively but spends cumulative subtotal at EACH [from,to) iteration. Pier calls are separate from actual election.

boundaries.derivation: Retain distinct stored HV and train-visible border predicates. Widen before multiplication; Int64 overflow rejects. Bankruptcy top-ups preserve source no-affordability policy and zero-cash boundary; nonpositive increment and subtract overflow reject without looping. These are detached arithmetic/boundary vectors, not live admission/rollback evidence.

drawing.derivation: SCN-031 six-pass traffic order is literal. Cut drawer passes cutZ-z+1, Mountain subtracts one but pier does not. Signal before uses needsToDrawAfter true; actual native rendering/occlusion remains later evidence.

slopeRemoval.derivation: Resolve every cardinal rail member to the same owning base. The distinctive second level has zdiff+1 in climb direction; all four rail car positions are protected. Incomplete owner/selected wrong direction rejects atomically. Eight cleared cells exclude elected piers; source teardown call sites are tested separately.

components.derivation: Minimal trusted component interfaces: special rails accept existing edges only; signal/pole zero booking; pole non-null replacement omits old onRemoved. Crossings require an empty accessory slot, straight cardinal rail and perpendicular road. Road-only Traffic remains speed-list eligible/retained. Stationary completion books price once; footprint demolition uses SUBSIDIARIES independent of height; cancellation costs zero. No moving trains/roads/platform UI or scheduler implementation credit.

coverage.review: All 12 normal/16 junction patterns and 32 slope patterns are exhaustive in matrices; retain invalid null-pattern source outcome.
All cardinal/level/paired cells, mixed local art, stored flags and eight obstruction slots.
No owner filter; no-op normal detach can still remove foreign piers; lower underground obstruction suppresses election only.
Operation-specific booking including charged unchanged endpoints and local occupied skips.
Detached oracle inputs remain unchanged; preview deltas for cash/allocator/terrain/entities/clock/random/listeners are all zero. Runtime must later prove them.
Bridge/girder include destination; tunnel/garage exclude it.
Build replacement fence differs from retained per-cell removal skips.
Checked coordinates, all footprint bounds before access, same-point and noncoplanar rejection, widened money/overflow.
Ordered dispatch/cut arithmetic only; no native visual fidelity claim.
Source component legality/zero booking and completion/demolition accounting interfaces only; later runtime consumers remain open.
